method_notes: Purpose: one consistent, directory-based yardstick of recurring folk activity across the 20 largest US metros (Census 2023 CBSA counties from msa_counties.txt). Only items located in those counties are counted (San Jose/Santa Clara, Boulder, Ann Arbor, Baltimore and Connecticut are excluded). Geography: towns were matched to Census 2023 Gazetteer place/county-subdivision internal points (national files) or to the directory's own coordinates, then assigned to counties by point-in-polygon against counties.geojson. Neighborhood names (e.g. Jamaica Plain, Brooklyn, Studio City) used directory coordinates or were mapped to their parent city. No Nominatim/Census-geocoder calls were needed. Frequency conversion: weekly = 4.33/month; every other week = 2.17; "1st and 3rd" = 2; "1st, 3rd and 5th" = 2.33; fifth-weekday only = 0.33; monthly = 1; "1st or 2nd" (one of) = 1; trycontra annual_freq/12. Seasonal series are counted at their in-season rate unless the directory gives an annual count. contra (PRIMARY): trycontra.com dances_locs.json (Jeff Kaufman's Try Contra; file Last-Modified 2026-10-26). Structured lat/lng, annual frequency and inactive flags; covers all 20 metros consistently. It lists no series names (name left blank; url identifies the series). Inactive entries are listed but excluded from totals. Coverage is selective (~1 entry per organizer series; e.g. only 5 Bay Area entries), so treat as a floor. contra_contradancelinks (SECONDARY, STALE): contradancelinks.com per-state pages, as requested. Every page says "As of January 1, 2021" and the latest dated listings are 2021-2022, so the venue section is a cumulative archive mixing current, defunct and one-off events. Only venue entries whose text states an explicit recurring frequency and whose title is not a one-off/workshop/festival were kept (heuristic parse, spot-checked); entries saying suspended/discontinued are flagged inactive and excluded. Squares/waltz/Scandinavian-only entries are excluded; ECD entries are counted separately. The Massachusetts/CT/RI page (schedule.html) was blocked by the corporate web filter (category "malware"), so Boston includes only its New Hampshire counties here. Colorado is linked to the external Colorado Contra Online venue page (dancingtheweb.com, itself last updated ~2023), used for Denver. venue_entries_in_metro_total shows how many raw venue entries the page has for the metro. sacred_harp: Sacred Harp Musical Heritage Association "2025 Minutes and 2026 Directory", Local Singings section (fasola.org/minutes, SacredHarpMinutesOnline2025.pdf), plus the one in-metro "Fifth Weekend (Regular Singings)" entry (Old Chicora/Lithia FL). This is the directory fasola.org points to; shapenotesingings.com/regular-singings/ (also linked) lists groups only with links, and has some misaligned rows. "book" is as printed; where none is printed it says so (most are presumably The Sacred Harp). "Most Sundays" counted as 3.5/month; "most months" as 0.9. Only regular local singings are counted (no annual all-day singings/conventions). The NYC line "New York City Singings: Information" is a pointer, not a singing, and is not counted. Out-of-CBSA singings excluded: Palo Alto (Santa Clara), Boulder, Ann Arbor, Baltimore, Princeton/Lawrenceville (Mercer NJ), Douglassville (Berks PA), Northfield MN, Whidbey Island, Kingston/Woodstock NY. rscds: groups = RSCDS branches and affiliated groups as mirrored on my.strathspey.org/groups/country/US/ (entries "generated automatically from public information on the RSCDS web site"); rscds.org itself returned a Cloudflare challenge/403. classes = adult and youth country-dance classes (not Highland/step/performance teams) taken from each branch's current class page where reachable (pages fetched Oct 30 2026), else from the branch description in the directory. weekly_class_count = per_month_total/4.33. Gaps noted per metro. morris: Tradfolk "Morris teams of the world" Google My Map (tradfolk.co/the-morris-map, KML export; practice location and night per team) located by town, plus team lists from the North American Morris Dance Organization regional pages (morrisdance.org, last edited 2021) where the NAMDO list gives a placeable location (state heading + place name or a shared club domain). NAMDO teams in the same state whose town cannot be determined from the directories are listed under namdo_listed_in_state_location_unknown and NOT counted. Teams NAMDO marks Ceased are excluded from team_count. americanmorrisnews.org, the Morris Ring and Open Morris sites did not resolve, and Wikipedia has no "List of morris dance sides" article. Coverage is incomplete (Tradfolk is UK-centric; NAMDO is a 2021 snapshot). comhaltas: comhaltas.ie branch listings (21 pages of the Dokan branch directory, which carries geocoded addresses). 41 US listings in total. ccena.org and other CCE North America sites did not resolve. Some well-known branches may be missing or listed under an officer/region name; the Midwest Regional Secretary listing is shown but excluded. cdss_calendar (PARTIAL): CDSS online events calendar via its public REST API, all events dated 2026-11-01..2026-11-30 (261 events nationally), online-only events excluded. Self-submitted by organizers, so it badly undercounts most metros (e.g. Boston 3 and Washington DC 1 in-person events for the month) and is included only as a cross-check and for English country dance. Not collected: international folk dance (folkdancefootnotes / Folk Dance Federation listings are regional, not national) and bluegrass jams (bluegrassjamfinder.com returned a 114-byte placeholder page). Treat these as missing, not zero.
